notes.title: Nephilim Uprising Version 0.0.7 LIVE NOW!
notes.notes:
We’re thrilled to announce that the highly anticipated major update for Nephilim Uprising is now live! This update brings a host of new features and improvements, including:

🌟 Updated Visual Graphics: The game has received a visual upgrade with improved graphics.

🎶 Updated Background Music: Immerse yourself in new, dynamic music.

⚔️ New Weapons & Rebalanced Damage: Discover powerful new weapons with updated damage values for a more balanced experience.

📈 Skill and Leveling Systems: Take control of your character’s growth with a new skill and skill point system.

💰 Improved Inventory System: A merchant and selling options have been added, along with a new currency system!

🛡️ Boss Levels Separated: Boss fights now have their own dedicated levels for a more epic battle experience.

🎮 Level Quality & Difficulty Adjustments: Expect improved levels and difficulty adjustments to keep the challenge exciting.

Let us know what you think and share your feedback with the community!
